wm = panel.pivot(index="id", columns="wave", values="mil")
wh = panel.pivot(index="id", columns="wave", values="hjs")
d = pd.DataFrame({"m1": wm[1], "m2": wm[2], "m3": wm[3], "h1": wh[1]})
g = np.random.default_rng(73)
steps = [("m2", ["m1", "h1"]), ("m3", ["m1", "m2", "h1"])]   # 빠진 값을 차례로 채운다
est = []
for _ in range(20):                                          # 20벌을 만든다
    z = d.copy()
    for y, xs in steps:
        ok = d[y].notna()
        X = np.column_stack([np.ones(ok.sum())] + [z.loc[ok, x] for x in xs])
        b = np.linalg.lstsq(X, z.loc[ok, y], rcond=None)[0]
        r = z.loc[ok, y] - X @ b
        s2 = (r @ r) / g.chisquare(len(r) - len(b))          # 잔차 분산을 뽑는다
        bd = g.multivariate_normal(b, s2 * np.linalg.inv(X.T @ X))   # 계수를 뽑는다
        Xm = np.column_stack([np.ones((~ok).sum())] + [z.loc[~ok, x] for x in xs])
        z.loc[~ok, y] = Xm @ bd + g.normal(0, np.sqrt(s2), (~ok).sum())   # 예측값 + 잡음
    bz, sez, *_ = ols(z.m3, [z.m1])
    est.append([z.m3.mean(), z.m1.corr(z.m3), bz[1], sez[1]])
e = np.array(est)
within = np.mean(e[:, 3] ** 2)                               # 벌 안 분산
between = np.var(e[:, 2], ddof=1)                            # 벌 사이 분산
se = np.sqrt(within + (1 + 1 / 20) * between)
print(e[:, :3].mean(0).round(3), round(se, 4), round(np.sqrt(within), 4))
